## What this changes

Short description of the change and the user impact.

## Why

The problem this solves or the reason for the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] `gofmt -l .` is clean
- [ ] `go vet ./...` passes
- [ ] `go build ./...` passes
- [ ] `go test ./... -count=1` passes
- [ ] `make checkdocs` passes (if docs or flags changed)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `## [Unreleased]` for user-facing changes
- [ ] No real tokens, secrets, or PEM keys committed
- [ ] AI-assisted changes are marked, and a human has tested this
